svg.title: dsh-construction-doc-check tree and set-level checks
svg.desc: The sample archive as the walk sees it: root, six category folders and twelve file leaves, each folder carrying the rule ids that matched a relative path there (CD-001..CD-030, all twelve present). Two set-level rules read the same files[] array as a set: CD-040 groups base names after stripping copy markers, CD-041 compares every file size with emptyFileBytes; both land at info. The run receipt closes the figure: 12 present, 0 missing, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 infos, 14 rules, 7 dirs, 12 files, 0 warnings; the scan is depth-capped at 6 and skips six directory names, and every skipped check says why.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: One archive tree, fourteen rules: twelve read a relative path, two read the set.
IN · dir -> 7 dirs · 12 files · path + name + bytes
